competing_explanation: The mismatch may be a small serialization or numerical-aggregation difference rather than missing scientific information, but R6 preregistered exact seed-to-ensemble replay as an input-validity gate and did not authorize a post-outcome tolerance change or alternate reconstruction.
evidence_interpretation: Category C post-hoc mechanism diagnostic stopped at its input gate. The placeholder factorial, attribution, interaction and risk CSVs contain no scientific cell estimates and must not be interpreted as negative mechanism evidence.
gate_reasons: All nine declared R5 assets passed SHA-256 and lifecycle verification, and R6-R2 completed with return code 0 without protected-data access.
The saved R5 candidate q05 score failed the preregistered exact arithmetic replay from the two saved per-seed q05 values.
Because the input/base-replay gate failed, the eight Action x Coverage x Risk counterfactual cells and their bootstrap attribution estimates were not computed.
The frozen terminal mapping therefore requires COMPLETED_GATE_INCONCLUSIVE and authorizes NONE.
limitations: R6 does not determine whether action identity, coverage ranking, risk veto, or their interaction is the dominant R5 decision failure.
The audit covers only the 384 R5 development images, folds 0/1, D_ref/D_rep and the frozen three-action bank; it provides no regional or external-validation result.
No post-hoc tolerance relaxation, score reconstruction, R5 rerun, threshold search, training, inference, confirmation, canary or locked-test access is authorized.
primary_result: R6-A0 is scientifically inconclusive: exact R5 seed-to-ensemble q05 replay failed before counterfactual attribution, so no decision component was confirmed, excluded, or ranked.
